qualifier: p53 and DREAM repression of cell cycle genes
name: G2/M progression and p53–DREAM repression of cell cycle genes
rationale: Members cover G2/M progression (MASTL, GTSE1) and p53/DREAM/p107-p130 transcriptional repression of cell cycle genes, unlike the APC/C mitotic-exit, RB-E2F G1/S and broader G2/M checkpoint confusables.

qualifier: histone/DNA methylation and chromatin remodelling complexes
name: Epigenetic silencing by histone/DNA methylation and chromatin remodelling
rationale: Members are histone and DNA methylation/demethylation, BAF/CHD/NuRD remodelling complexes, imprinting and X inactivation, whereas confusables centre on protein and tubulin acetylation and nucleosome assembly.

name: Disuse-induced skeletal muscle atrophy via SCF ubiquitin proteolysis
rationale: Members concern muscle atrophy from inactivity and SCF-dependent proteasomal catabolism, distinguishing them from confusables on cardiac adaptation, hypertrophy and myoblast differentiation.

qualifier: SOS activation, GAP inactivation and oncogenic RAS/NF1 mutants
name: RAS GTPase regulation by SOS and GAPs, including oncogenic mutants
rationale: Members cover RAS activation by SHC/SOS, inactivation by GAPs and RAS/GAP/NF1 mutants, upstream of the RAF/MAPK, p38 and ERK-feedback confusables.

name: Peroxide and hypoxic stress responses promoting ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to hydroperoxides, H2O2, ischemia and H2S plus ferroptosis promotion, distinguished from confusables on nitrosative stress, apoptosis regulation and respiration.

name: Pre-rRNA synthesis and processing by spacer cleavage
rationale: Members are 5'-ETS, ITS1 and ITS2 cleavages and 5'-end processing of the tricistronic pre-rRNA plus Pol I rRNA transcription activation, unlike the Pol I/III elongation-termination and ribosome biogenesis regulation confusables.

name: RAF–MEK activation by RAS/MRAS and oncogenic RAF mutants
rationale: Members cover RAF and MAP2K activation, MRAS-SHOC2 complexes and BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K mutant signalling, versus confusables on integrin linkage, RAF fusions, Rap1 and ERK negative feedback.

core: Plasma membrane solute and ion transporters
name: Plasma membrane SLC solute and ion transporters
rationale: Members are broad transcriptional modules of plasma-membrane SLC and ion transporters, whereas confusables are specific organic ion, amino acid, urate and hexose transport processes.

qualifier: transition and heavy metal plus heme uptake
name: Metal ion and heme uptake, homeostasis and detoxification
rationale: Members span zinc, copper, iron, manganese and heavy metal transport, responses, metallothioneins and heme scavenging/HMOX1, unlike the heme biosynthesis, ascorbate and oxygen-sensing confusables.

qualifier: telomerase recruitment, capping and recombination suppression
name: Telomerase recruitment, telomere capping and recombination suppression
rationale: Members cover telomerase assembly and Cajal body trafficking, telomere capping and ATRX/DAXX inhibition of telomeric recombination, versus confusables on C-strand synthesis and replication-based maintenance.

name: MTF1–metallothionein response to cadmium and other heavy metals
rationale: Members are MTF1 and metallothionein responses to cadmium, zinc, copper, iron and mercury, lacking the zinc transporter and cobalt/lead/selenium members of confusables.

name: Sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading, establishment and resolution of cohesion, chromosome condensation and CENP-A chromatin assembly, unlike spindle, meiotic recombination and nucleosome assembly confusables.

name: VEGF–neuropilin and angiopoietin–Tie2 signalling in endothelium
rationale: Members are VEGF/VEGFR/neuropilin binding, Tie2 signalling, lymphangiogenesis and endothelial survival, versus confusables on sprouting angiogenesis and VEGFR2 regulation.

name: Carnitine-dependent fatty acid oxidation and acyl-CoA metabolism
rationale: Members cover carnitine transport/shuttle, long- and medium-chain fatty acid catabolism and malonyl/succinyl-CoA metabolism, versus confusables on individual beta-oxidation steps and ketone bodies.

qualifier: lipid-modified Wnt and Hedgehog ligand secretion
name: Cysteine palmitoylation and lipid-modified Wnt/Hedgehog ligand secretion
rationale: Members are S-palmitoylation/depalmitoylation and PORCN/HHAT lipidation enabling Wnt and Hedgehog ligand release, unlike confusables on geranylgeranylation, Hh autoprocessing and non-canonical Wnt.

qualifier: SUMO maturation, deconjugation and DNA repair targets
name: SUMO maturation, deconjugation and SUMOylation of DNA repair proteins
rationale: Members are SUMO processing, desumoylation and SUMOylation of DNA repair, nuclear envelope, RNA-binding and ubiquitin pathway proteins, versus confusables on E1/E2 conjugation and chromatin/transcription substrates.

name: Catecholamine and serotonin synthesis, reuptake, degradation and sympathoadrenal development
rationale: Members cover biosynthesis, vesicular loading, SLC6 reuptake and MAO/COMT degradation of monoamines plus sympathetic/adrenal development, versus confusables on amino acid transmitters, dopamine receptor signalling and BH4.

name: Brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and thermogenic restraint
rationale: Members concern brown/beige adipocyte differentiation and negative regulation of adipose development, PPAR signalling and cold-induced thermogenesis, versus white adipogenesis and fatty acid transport confusables.

name: Regulation of monocyte, macrophage, granulocyte and dendritic cell differentiation
rationale: Members regulate monocyte, macrophage, granulocyte and myeloid dendritic cell differentiation (including GM-CSF response), versus confusables on neutrophil/G-CSF, M-CSF and myeloid progenitor programmes.

name: Osmotic volume regulation via cation–chloride cotransporters and Na+/H+ exchangers
rationale: Members are osmosensory responses, renal sodium/chloride transport and SLC12/SLC9 transporter defects, versus confusables on potassium channels and SLC26/bicarbonate anion exchange.

name: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism and galactosemias
rationale: All members concern the Leloir pathway and its GALT/GALM deficiencies, distinguishing it from fructose, pentose and gluconeogenesis confusables.

qualifier: amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Organic acid metabolism and amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids
rationale: Members are broad organic acid/amide metabolism plus glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate, versus confusables on specific amino acid metabolism.

qualifier: DVL activation and destruction complex disassembly
name: Wnt-induced DVL activation and destruction complex disassembly
rationale: Members cover Wnt activation of DVL, AXIN recruitment to the membrane and positive canonical Wnt regulation, versus confusables on destruction complex mutants, beta-catenin phosphorylation and TCF target repression.

name: TNFR1 signalling and canonical NF-kB transcription factor regulation
rationale: Members cover TNFR1 NF-kB and proapoptotic signalling, linear polyubiquitination and NF-kB activity regulation, versus confusables on non-canonical NF-kB and TLR/RIP1 IKK recruitment.

name: Energy substrate transport and creatine–phosphocreatine energy buffering
rationale: Members are lactate/pyruvate, glucose, carnitine and mitochondrial ATP transport plus creatine/phosphocreatine metabolism, versus confusables on di-/tricarboxylate and organic ion transport and the malate-aspartate shuttle.
